correctness.rationale: The classical minimally imperfect graph theorem fixes exactly one fractional QSTAB vertex a=(1/m)1 and the rank cut sum(x)<=2; these are credited assumptions, not derived by experiment. The n maximal cliques of the complement of C_(2m+1) form a nonsingular circulant tight system; their n opposite edge-indicator neighbors bound the entire removed simplex. For B=I+cyclic shift, det(B-a1^T)=-1/m, hence Euclidean volume 1/(m n!). Dirichlet barycentric second moments yield n(2-2/m+2/m^2)/((n+1)(n+2)); iid Exp construction and a one-dependent CLT yield covariance [[1,12],[12,164]] and delta-method variance (-12,1) Cov (-12,1)^T=20. Independently computed maximal cliques, determinants and exact means for n=5,7,9,11, plus rechecked CLT moment algebra. The finite cases are diagnostics; the cited theorem and analytic CLT support every odd n>=5.
